record_notes.DCP-LETT-1018: November 6 inferred Friday from near-complete paper and subsequent November 12 appointment note. Answers missing Hooker letter and rough barnacle drawings, reports two more mornings dissecting and continued doubt about ovisac/inner tunic. Planned paper to Owen next week is not actual dispatch; actual November 25 evidence separate. Invites meetings November 18–21 and working visit; Sertulariae offer and Bombay expedition news have missing input. Four sick days do not establish arrival day. P4 2½ hours flattened as 212 requires fraction repair.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1022: November 12 inferred Thursday, linked to London visit plan in 1018. Repeats request for appointment response, now believes no ovisac and newly observes abortive anterior penis; this revises doubt in 1018 rather than inheriting later anatomical interpretation. Microscope advice, porcupine quills and sauce thanks refer prior gifts/oral advice, not surviving new prompt. Wrist-support blocks newly invented. Self-continuation is not incoming-response pair.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1024: November 14 Saturday Morning. Thanks new lenses and answers missing Hooker statement that he has no other London business. Offers Thursday or Friday Kew visit conditional on health, with fallback Friday 11½ at Park Street. Microscopy with new lens planned this morning, not evidence completed. P3 time fraction flattened as 1112 requires repair. Incoming practical note absent; cannot use own 1022 as prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1025: November 15 Sunday. Explicitly corrects own yesterday proposal in 1024 because Thursday already engaged; now Friday Kew unless Hooker prefers London. Exact own-letter continuation supports sequence, not a Darwin training reply to Darwin. Still asks incoming answer at Park Street, so no invented acceptance.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1027: November 17 Tuesday. Answers missing Hooker note with three-bed offer, accepts Kew Friday before lunch but cannot stay. Earlier outgoing arrangements give chain context, not the incoming invitation. Future arrival remains plan; visit subsequently attested by 1031 thanks and editorial diary evidence, not this letter alone.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1031: November 23 inferred Monday after Kew visit. Has read Hooker manuscript pretty carefully, promises repeated reading when printed; detailed page-numbered critique of mountains, moisture, sterility, Cape Verde, St Jago sentence, Compositae, species/genus ratio, affinity/analogy, plant geographical types, table arithmetic and seed dispersal. Current manuscript version absent; published final paper must not be substituted as exact incoming text. P15 quarter-hour fraction flattened as 14 needs repair; arithmetic 96–15=81 and reverse-question-mark convention preserved. Returns lens and asks sister health. Modern summary gives 1851 publication, while footnote identifies December 1846 readings; do not date possession of print to November 1846.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1032: November 24 inferred Tuesday before Linnean reading. Surviving incoming fragment directly answers 1031 St Jago grammar, Compositae ubiquity, genera/species ratios, Juan Fernandez/St Helena affinity, Panama/Mexican types and column arithmetic. Enclosed remodelled passage is requested back but not preserved here; text ends mid-sentence. Marginal Darwin note about connecting forms into species and number 20 are undated and not Hooker body. No surviving subsequent Darwin reply in this packet; do not invert this reverse edge.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1035: December Saturday, exact day unassigned. Answers missing Hooker note about January work visit and response to a speech; dental abscess, proposed father visit, coal plants from Melville Island, compound microscope purchase and missing lady-neighbour prospectus. Bunbury/Hooker speech identification is only possible in notes, not certain. December 5 Leonard payment is not proof of this letter day or drawing session day. Nearly three months on Cirripedia and three genera are contemporaneous estimates, not a precise dated-section division. P4 1/30-inch microscope fraction flattened as 130th requires repair. Thanks corallines and sister news; none of these supplied by 1032 draft-editing reply.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1036: Wednesday December 1846–January 1847 raw boundary range. Proposes Saturday the 16th (January 16 per editorial note and calendar), train 3:15, phaeton priority, old set and Lyells. It is a proposed future visit, not receipt or completed-event evidence. Conditional internal upper bound is before January 16, and a Wednesday would be at latest January 13, but keep original range/period hold and do not select an exact Wednesday. Missing Hooker scheduling note; 1035 own outgoing January plans not an incoming prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1007: October 8 Thursday: asks Corallina/Nullipora book for intended paper and thanks Hooker for coming. Hooker acceptance not preserved; 998 conditional proposal predates fixed invitation, and 1006 is own outgoing. Forbes in Wales, Falconer no answer, Allen travel arrangement. Later absence of the proposed paper is editorial evidence, not proof of a completed paper in 1846. Reused full primary body/notes reading from batch08; editorial bibliography additionally read now.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1015: October 18 Sunday: conditional Kew visit following artist work on Arthrobalanus, lunch near one, absence by two means prevented. Thanks missing omnibus note, asks response at Erasmus address. Future clock times are plans, not precise composition or actual visit times. Current incoming note and accepted invitation absent. Reused full primary body/notes reading from batch08; editorial bibliography additionally read now.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1012: October 26 Monday Morning. Thanks Hooker for barnacle drawings/observations and asks six numbered anatomical/drawing questions; returns lens, own lens altered for 3s6d, PS asks about inner tunic and ovisac. Hooker drawings are not found; absent visual input must not become a synthetic question. Full numbered structure, anatomical uncertainty and PS preserved. Later 1854 description/name are not 1846 knowledge. Reused full primary body/notes reading from batch08; editorial bibliography additionally read now.
